instruction.text: Connor schreibt an den Kummerkasten der Schule. Vervollständige den Brief, indem du die Wörter in die passenden Lücken schiebst.

trainers.finishSound: Dear Ms. Advice, I have a problem and I need help. My big sister and I always argue about the smallest things. I haven't done anything wrong and she starts a fight. She overreacts all the time! One time she even screamed at me just because I borrowed her skates. I don't know how to react and she never apologises. What should I do? Connor

instruction.text: Vervollständige nun die Antwort des Kummerkastens an Connor.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to trust</voice> bedeutet vertrauen <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to mistrust</voice> bedeutet mistrauen <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to recommend</voice> bedeutet empfehlen

atoms.b:
Dear Connor,
I know it can be difficult with siblings. Have you ever thought about your own behaviour? Maybe your sister ((++mistrusts trusts)) you because you take her things without permission. That may be the reason she becomes ((++angry happy)) so fast. I would recommend you to talk to her about your feelings and tell her that you feel ((++sorry happy)) for taking her things without asking beforehand. At the same time, listen to what she is ((++upset_about looking_forward_to)). I hope you will get along better after that. Talk to your parents if that doesn't help.
Yours sincerely, Ms. Advice

instruction.text: Ein anonymer Schreiber schreibt an den Kummerkasten der Schule. Vervollständige den Brief, indem du die Wörter in die passenden Lücken schiebst.

trainers.finishSound: Dear Ms. Advice, I don't know what to do. My friend always gets nicer things than I do. Also, if he wishes for something he gets it. When I want to have something, I often have to pay for it myself. That is so unfair! Please help me. anonymous writer.

instruction.text: Vervollständige nun die Antwort des Kummerkastens an den anonymen Schreiber.

atoms.b:
Dear anonymous writer,
I can totally see why you're feeling uncomfortable with that situation. Still, you must ((++accept argue trust)) that your friend hasn't got the same parents as you and is treated differently. I am sure your parents don't want you to ((++feel_hurt be_interested look_forward)). Maybe they just want to ((++teach worry annoy)) you how to handle your own money. So, try not to be ((++upset overreact funny)) but try to see the good in it.
Yours sincerely, Ms. Advice
